outcome: maternal physical health problems (fatigue, back pain, haemorrhoids, urinary incontinence)
breastfeeding problems (nipple pain/damage, difficulty attaching, low milk supply, mastitis, engorgement, breast refusal, too much milk)
cohort: The study included 1760 resident Croatian women, aged 18+ years, who had given birth in a Croatian maternity facility between February 2020 and December 2021 and had enrolled in an online antenatal course.
finding: Croatian women experienced many physical health challenges (e.g., fatigue, back pain) and breastfeeding problems (e.g., nipple pain/damage in 50%) in the first six months postpartum.
mod_finding: Low milk supply and engorgement were higher in women with Caesarean births.
followup_time: first six months after giving birth
